temperature, different time: thickness decides how long the heat takes to reach the middle. Size Air fryer Oven Thin strips, about 1 oz each 400°F / 205°C · 8 min 425°F / 220°C · 11 min Whole tenderloins, about 2 oz 400°F / 205°C · 10 min 425°F / 220°C · 13 min Thick strips, 3 oz and over 400°F / 205°C · 12 min 425°F / 220°C · 16 min Done one minute, dry the next A tender is a narrow strip with almost no fat and a lot of surface. Hot air reaches every side at once, so the whole piece heats through in a few minutes, and there is no thick middle to buffer a mistake. Leave a basket of tenders for two extra minutes while you mix a dip and they shrink, tighten and turn stringy. The white tendon running through a whole tenderloin makes it worse, because it contracts in the heat and curls the strip. Treat tenders like a quick cook rather than a roast: pull the tendon, cut strips to one thickness, start checking a minute before the time, and lift them out as soon as the thickest strip is done. Breaded tenders protect the meat a little but need a light spray of oil so the crumb browns before the inside overcooks. Worked example A pound of whole tenderloins, tendons removed, dipped in egg and panko and sprayed lightly with oil. Preheat 4 minutes, lay them flat without overlapping and cook at 400°F for 10 minutes, turning at 5. Thin strips cut from a breast are done in about 8 minutes and fat ones in about 12. On a rack in a conventional oven the same batch takes 425°F for roughly 13 minutes and comes out paler. How to tell they are done Measure the thickest tender from the end, pushing the probe lengthways into the middle: 165°F (74°C) is done. Strips are too thin to hold a lot of carryover heat, so they will not climb much after they come out. Without a thermometer, break the fattest one in half; it should be white with no glassy centre and the juices should run clear. A breaded coating should be golden all over, not pale where pieces touched. Before they go in Pull out the white tendon by pinning its end with a fork and sliding the meat away. For breading, set up flour, beaten egg and panko, and press the crumbs on firmly so they do not blow around the fan. A 15-minute soak in salted buttermilk keeps plain tenders juicier. Leave a finger-width gap between strips. Related presets Chicken breast 375°F · 16 min · flip at 8 Chicken wings 400°F · 22 min · flip at 11 Chicken thighs 380°F · 24 min · flip at 12 425°F oven to air fryer, every food → Oven to air fryer converter → All food presets → Printable conversion chart → Frequently asked questions How long do chicken tenders take in the air fryer? About 10 minutes at 400°F for whole fresh tenderloins, flipped at 5 minutes. Thin strips take around 8 minutes and thick ones around 12. What temperature are chicken tenders done at? 165°F (74°C) in the thickest piece. Because they are thin, take them out right at that reading. Do breaded tenders need oil in the air fryer? A light spray, yes. Dry crumbs stay pale and dusty without a little fat to help them brown. Can I cook frozen breaded tenders with this setting? No. Shop-bought frozen tenders are par-cooked and follow the pack instructions; use frozen mode for those. What would the oven setting be? 425°F for around 13 minutes in a conventional oven, or 400°F for 11 minutes with the fan on. mainEntity.name: How long do chicken tenders take in the air fryer?

acceptedAnswer.text: About 10 minutes at 400°F for whole fresh tenderloins, flipped at 5 minutes. Thin strips take around 8 minutes and thick ones around 12.

mainEntity.name: What temperature are chicken tenders done at?

acceptedAnswer.text: 165°F (74°C) in the thickest piece. Because they are thin, take them out right at that reading.

mainEntity.name: Do breaded tenders need oil in the air fryer?

acceptedAnswer.text: A light spray, yes. Dry crumbs stay pale and dusty without a little fat to help them brown.

mainEntity.name: Can I cook frozen breaded tenders with this setting?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Shop-bought frozen tenders are par-cooked and follow the pack instructions; use frozen mode for those.

mainEntity.name: What would the oven setting be?

acceptedAnswer.text: 425°F for around 13 minutes in a conventional oven, or 400°F for 11 minutes with the fan on.
